blocks.title: CenterSpeed
blocks.tagline: Speedometer for TrackMania Nations and United Forever: your speed in the middle of the screen or on the license plate.

items.title: Speedometer
items.text: Speed in the middle of the screen, or drawn on the license plate of the car.

items.title: Checkpoint times
items.text: Speed and time at each checkpoint, with the difference to your best run.

items.title: Live tracking and spectating
items.text: Compare against another player online and see speed and times of the player you spectate.

items.title: Settings on F8
items.text: Size, position, gears, RPM bars and plate settings per environment.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown:
1. Install the TrackMania ModLoader and start it once.
2. Add `https://fullspeed.mooo.com/modloader/` under the servers in `%LocalAppData%\TMLoader\config.yaml`.
3. Install CenterSpeed from the list and tick it. ModLoader installs CoreMod, which CenterSpeed needs, by itself.

Updates arrive automatically each time ModLoader starts.
